It waits for both real globals, compares both identities, rebinds only a changed Instructions store after unsubscribing the old store, refreshes the read model when Books changes with the same store, and ignores callbacks from replaced or unmounted stores. It never forces dataState or invents a read model; entity/basis/period, tie-out, approval, posting/receipt and actual-versus-projected contracts remain unchanged.

contractReview.description: Books workstation — GL, trial balance, reconciliation, FX reval, gated period close, consolidation. Entity scope is a path in the ownership tree (group ▸ fund ▸ SPV); group scope renders consolidated figures with the elimination layer disclosed, each elimination tracing to its JE pair. Journal posting is the GL screen's compose mode (view=gl&compose=1); a GL row opens its whole entry in the inspector drawer, where the only correction the books allow is a reversal.

Source and dependency review is not behavioral execution; the coordinator attaches the current full49-entry matrix.

a11y.ua: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/151.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

results.check: Document has system focus at start (focus() and activeElement are only meaningful when it does)
Ordered list with progress semantics, aria-current on the current step, no tab roles
results.observed: ol=true · aria-current count=1 · li[1] text="2Step 2 of 4, current: Thesis" · tab roles=0

results.check: Radio group, one tab stop, Arrow moves focus AND selects, Home/End, disabled skipped
results.observed: radiogroup=true · tab stops=1 · → skipped disabled B → focus "C" value c · End → d · Home → a

results.check: Label associated via aria-labelledby; formatted aria-valuetext; PageUp steps
results.observed: name="Min yield" · valuetext 2.00% → 3.00% after 4 steps (PageUp is native range behaviour; stepped programmatically here — the label/valuetext contract is what the component owns)

results.check: Tablist with roving focus; aria-controls only resolves to an existing panel
results.observed: tabs=3 · selected=1 · → focus "Reconciliation3" · dangling aria-controls=0 · tabpanel=true

results.check: Named combobox (label + value), ArrowDown opens listbox with aria-activedescendant on a real option, Escape closes and keeps trigger focus
results.observed: name="Security AAPL · Apple Inc." · open=true listbox=true · activedescendant → option "MSFT · Microsoft Corp." · Esc closed=true focus on trigger=true

results.check: Grid with row/col counts; arrows move aria-activedescendant to a named cell; Enter edits; Escape returns focus to the grid
results.observed: rowcount=4 colcount=4 · → active cell "B1, 2" · Enter → input focused=true · Esc → grid focused=true

results.check: Real tablist: arrows + Home/End move selection and focus; tabpanel labelled by its tab; unproven section absent
results.observed: tabs=summary/sources/audit (calculation, lineage absent, not blank) · → selected+focused=true · End → Audit · panel labelled by selected tab=true

results.check: Dividers are separators with orientation + two-region valuetext; arrow resizes 4% and stops at minSize
results.observed: orientation=vertical · valuetext "50% Exception queue, 50% Case" · → 50→54 · 30× ← stops at 15% (minSize .3 of 2 size units = 15%)

results.check: Collapsing a region while focus is inside it moves focus to the labelled rail, not body
results.observed: after collapse (focus was on the collapse button inside the region): activeElement=BUTTON "Expand Case"

results.check: Modified status: how many times the live region mutates for one arrow-key step, and for eight
results.observed: status present=true "Modified" · inserted 1× after the first step, 1× after nine steps; text mutations 0. The element is inserted once and never re-rendered — so Chromium's tree changes once. Whether NVDA announces the insertion once, or re-reads on each 4% step, is the OPEN half.

results.check: Disclosure not menu (no aria-haspopup), aria-controls resolves, Escape closes and focus stays on the trigger
results.observed: trigger "Recent 2 objects, 2 in this session" · aria-haspopup=none · open: panel found=true expanded=true · Esc: closed=true focus on trigger=true

results.check: Modal dialog with combobox+listbox; arrows move aria-selected; Enter runs; Escape closes and returns focus to the opener
results.observed: dialog=true · input focused on open=true · ↓ selected "Open positions" · Enter ran=b · Esc closed=true · focus returned to opener=true

results.check: Every row states its fate in words, and the queue is a live region
results.observed: live region=true (aria-live=polite) · rows rendered=0, with a fate word=0 — no row could be submitted from this harness (hook API differs); fate wording is verified by the component's own card

results.check: Provisional state is a live-region word, then Confirmed; revert opens a named dialog with focus on the reason field; Escape returns focus to the revert control
results.observed: mark aria-live=polite "Provisional" (data-status=pending) → "Confirmed" · prior named "was 12%" · Revert… → dialog "Revert this cell" reason field focused=true · Esc closed=true focus back on Revert…=true

results.check: ¶ is a disclosure (aria-expanded, no aria-haspopup) opening a named dialog; click does not propagate to the row; Escape closes and keeps focus on ¶
results.observed: aria-haspopup=none · name "1 annotation, some stale on Weight" · expanded false→true · dialog "Annotations · Weight" · row onClick fired 0× (propagation stopped) · Esc closed=true focus on ¶=true

results.check: Toggles are aria-pressed; cap refusal is stated in words (disabled + title) not silently dropped; tray is a named region with count; sheet is a named dialog, Escape closes it
results.observed: pressed=2 · third toggle disabled=true title "Compare set is full (2)" · tray region "2 of 2" · Compare → dialog "Comparison by selection" · Esc closed=true
